chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The woman is buried up to her middle, then the Imam throws, and the people throw with small stones. And the man, when he is stoned, is not buried except up to his loins.

key_terms.أَحْجَارٍ صِغَارٍ: small stones used in carrying out the stoning
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam who initiates the act mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman upon whom the punishment is carried out
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: is buried in the ground as part of the legal procedure described
key_terms.حَقْوَيْهِ: his loins, indicating the burial depth for the man
key_terms.رُجِمَ: was stoned or is subjected to stoning
key_terms.يُدْفَنُ: is buried, referring here to the man in the procedure

ai.seo_question: How is burial depth described for a man and a woman in the hadith on rajm?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the manner in which rajm is carried out, distinguishing between the burial depth of a woman and that of a man. It also mentions that the Imam begins the stoning, followed by the people, using small stones.
